OptionDesc.IncludeSatelliteImage: Include a satellite image of the playable map when exporting a loaded city. This feature is experimental. Turn off this option if the satellite image displays incorrectly or causes export problems. Including the image increases the exported map file size.
OptionLabel.ExportGuide:
Export the current city to create and view a city map.
Choose Export and Open to view it now, or Export Only to save the file.
OptionLabel.IncludeOutsideTerrain: Include terrain outside the playable map
OptionDesc.IncludeOutsideTerrain: Also export background terrain and water outside the playable map. This significantly increases file size and loading cost. Enable for surrounding mountains or the full background.
OptionDesc.ExportStatus: Shows the current progress, result, and first warning. Other warnings are in the exported file.
OptionDesc.LastCounts: Node / network / building / stop / line counts.
OptionDesc.InstallRenderer: Windows shows “Uses all system resources” for desktop apps. The viewer uses your Windows account permissions to open exported maps and save images.
OptionDesc.Version: The version of the mod you have installed.
OptionDesc.ExportCurrentCity: Save the current city as a .cmm file without opening the viewer.
OptionDesc.OpenExportFolder: Open the export folder in the system file manager. If it cannot be opened, the path is copied instead.
OptionDesc.CopyExportFolderPath: Copy the full export folder path to the clipboard.
